evals.prompt: Review a diff that changes an API page size default from 50 to 20 while the mobile client assumes all records arrive in one request.
evals.expected_output: A result that trace consumers; identify the realistic data-loss-like UI symptom; rank the finding while avoiding focus on code style.
expectations: The result identify the realistic data-loss-like UI symptom
The result does not focus on code style

evals.prompt: The edited file contains an old inefficient query unrelated to this one-line copy change.
evals.expected_output: A review scoped to the copy diff that does not turn an unrelated pre-existing query into a blocking finding.
expectations: The result keeps review scoped to the diff
The result distinguishes changed behavior from pre-existing code
The result does not report the unrelated pre-existing issue as a blocking finding

evals.prompt: Review a new authenticated endpoint that returns any invoice by numeric id.
evals.expected_output: A result that check object-level authorization; explain a concrete cross-tenant trigger and impact while avoiding treat authentication as sufficient authorization.
expectations: The result explain a concrete cross-tenant trigger and impact
The result does not treat authentication as sufficient authorization

evals.prompt: Review a focused patch whose new boundary and failure behavior are covered by tests and preserve existing contracts.
evals.expected_output: A result that say there are no blocking findings; mention only genuine residual verification gaps while avoiding invent a finding to appear thorough.
expectations: The result say there are no blocking findings
The result mention only genuine residual verification gaps
The result does not invent a finding to appear thorough
